hero.headline: {0}, we're getting married in the heart of the Lion City and we will be delighted to have you join us as we celebrate our love.

ourStory.heading: Our Story
ourStory.body: A little timeline of the ordinary days, brave choices, shared miles, and cups of coffee that brought us here.

metAtWork.title: Where It Began
metAtWork.body: We first met at work, not knowing that a simple introduction would quietly become the first page of our story.

coffeeRuns.title: Coffee, Runs, and Us
coffeeRuns.body: Our relationship began over coffee, then grew through cafe-hopping, steady conversations, and the joy of running side by side.

longDistance.title: Across the Miles
longDistance.body: For a short season, love stretched across distance when Mead moved to Singapore to begin a new chapter in her career.

lionCity.title: To the Lion City
lionCity.body: Soon after, Eleaz followed the love of her life to Singapore, choosing work, home, and everyday life with Mead.

fluffyEra.title: Our Softest Season
fluffyEra.body: We were so happy and settled together that we became the chubbiest, fluffiest, cutest version of ourselves.

fitnessJourney.title: Back to the Road
fitnessJourney.body: After walking through life's highs and lows together, we began our fitness journey and returned to one of our first love languages: running together.

proposal.title: The Yes
proposal.body: Eleaz proposed to Mead, and a promise we had been building day by day became our next forever.

bigDay.title: The Big Day
bigDay.body: We will begin our married life surrounded by the people who have loved, prayed for, and cheered us on.

venues.heading: Venues
venues.body: Two beautiful places will hold the most meaningful parts of our day: a sacred beginning and a celebration by the bay.

church.name: St. Joseph's Church (Victoria Street) 2:00 PM
church.description: A historic Catholic church in the heart of Singapore, where quiet beauty, tradition, and prayer will frame the beginning of our married life.

reception.name: The Lighthouse Fullerton 6:00 PM
reception.description: Perched atop The Fullerton Hotel Singapore on the 8th floor, an elegant rooftop dining overlooking Marina Bay, where dinner, heartfelt stories, and the glow of the city lights will carry the celebration into the evening.

rsvp.heading: RSVP

deadline.closedMessage: RSVP updates are now closed. Thank you for your understanding.

rsvp.note: We understand that attending our wedding will involve travelling for some of you, and we truly appreciate the additional time, effort, and arrangements you will make. At the same time, please know that there is absolutely no pressure. While having you celebrate with us would make us very happy, your love and well wishes are equally cherished.
rsvp.successMessage: Thank you! Your RSVP has been successfully submitted.
rsvp.successNote: You may use your invitation link again to update your response before the RSVP deadline.
rsvp.confirmBody: Please review before submitting. You may update your response again before the RSVP deadline.
rsvp.reviewReminder: Please note that there are two St. Joseph’s Churches in Singapore. Our wedding ceremony will be held at St. Joseph’s Church, Victoria Street. Kindly double-check the address before making your way to the church to avoid any confusion.
rsvp.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or contact us directly.

inviteOnly.message: Only invited guests can send an RSVP and attend the event. Please use the invitation link shared by the couple.

search.notFound: We could not verify this invitation link. Please

beef.description: Confit potato, chanterelle mushroom, seasonal vegetables, red wine reduction

fish.description: Fennel-potato puree, seasonal vegetables, chablis cream, truffle butter seared

weddingTimeline.heading: Wedding Timeline
weddingTimeline.body: A glimpse of how our day will unfold, from the ceremony to the evening celebration. While we will do our best to follow the schedule, timings may vary slightly on the day.
weddingTimeline.note: We will share more in-depth details of the timeline closer to the big day, so please stay tuned on this website.

partyAssembles.title: Wedding Party Assembles
partyAssembles.description: Immediate family members and the wedding entourage gather and prepare for the ceremony to begin.

ceremonyBegins.title: Ceremony Begins
ceremonyBegins.description: We begin our wedding Mass surrounded by family, friends, and prayer.

massConcludes.title: Wedding Mass Concludes
massConcludes.description: Following the Mass, we invite you to stay for group photographs at the church. We will then reunite later for an evening of celebration at the dinner reception.

break.description: There will be a few hours of free time between the ceremony and dinner reception. Please feel free to relax, explore nearby attractions, or return to your accommodation to freshen up before the evening celebration.

guestArrival.title: Guest Arrival at The Lighthouse Fullerton
guestArrival.description: We gather once more to continue the celebration at our evening reception.

dinnerBegins.title: Dinner Begins
dinnerBegins.description: Dinner, speeches, laughter, and celebration begin as the city lights settle in.

sde.title: A Special Wedding Film
sde.description: We have prepared a Same-Day Edit featuring moments from our wedding day, and we would love for you to stay until the end of the programme and watch it with us before the evening comes to a close.

receptionConcludes.title: Reception Concludes
receptionConcludes.description: We close the evening with full hearts.

whatToWear.heading: What to Wear

ladies.heading: For Ladies
ladies.body: Dresses, elegant jumpsuits, or dressy separates are welcome. We would love to see you in soft pink or light brown. We advise to leave the white dresses for the bride!

gentlemen.heading: For Gentlemen
gentlemen.body: A suit, blazer with tailored trousers, or a long-sleeved dress shirt with formal trousers is recommended. Please avoid shorts, jeans, T-shirts, and slippers. Black, brown, gray, white or soft pink are welcome.

whatToWear.closing: We invite you to dress elegantly and comfortably for our church ceremony and evening celebration.

giftRegistry.heading: A note on gifts
giftRegistry.body: Should you wish to bless us with a wedding gift,
giftRegistry.closing: a monetary contribution toward our future together would be sincerely appreciated.

questionsAndAnswers.heading: Questions & Answers
questionsAndAnswers.body: A few helpful notes as you prepare to celebrate with us.

rsvpDeadline.question: When should I RSVP?
rsvpDeadline.answer: Kindly send your RSVP by 31 October 2026 so we can make the final arrangements in time.

plusOnes.question: Can I bring a plus one?
plusOnes.answer: As we have reserved a specific number of seats, we can only accommodate the guests named on your invitation. If a plus one is included, their name will appear on your invitation's RSVP section. Unfortunately, we will not be able to accommodate unlisted guests. Thank you for understanding.

dressCode.question: What should I wear?
dressCode.answer: Formal or cocktail attire is requested. For ladies, soft pink and light brown are welcome, while white dresses are reserved for the bride. For gentlemen, black, brown, gray, white or soft pink are welcome.

timelineDetails.question: Will you share a more detailed timeline?
timelineDetails.answer: Yes. We will share more in-depth details closer to the big day, so please stay tuned on this website.

footer.message: Website Made with Love by the Groom and the Bride.
